ALL CODING BY THE CAREBEARS, MUZEXX BY -MAD, THE SLEEPER, MAX- (OF THE EXCEPTIONS, SCHMUCK!).  FONT BY THE NIGHTHAWKS (WHACK OF STARLIGHT SENT ME AN INTRO COLLECTION BY THE BLACK CATS YESTERDAY. THE AMIGA-FONT-RIPPING-SYNDROME SEEMS TO HAVE HIT THE ST TOO. MORE THAN HALF OF THOSE INTROS USED THIS FONT).  MOUNTAINS BY A.D.    I WRITE THIS TEXT THE DAY AFTER THE -WHATTAHECK- DEMO WAS RELEASED.  EVERYBODY IS COMPLAINING, TELLING US THAT IF WE DON'T RELEASE THIS DEMO SOON, THEY WILL START FUCKING GREET US.       I ACTUALLY HAVE PROCESSOR TIME LEFT IN THIS DEMO, BUT I DON'T HAVE NO MEMORY LEFT. IT'S AGAINST OUR PRINCIPLES NOT TO USE EVERY DARNED ONE OF THOSE 160256 VBL-CYCLES.  BUT IF THIS DEMO IS GOING TO BE RELEASED THIS YEAR, WE SIMPLY HAVE TO BE SATISFIED WITH ALMOST PERFECT SCREENS...   AS WE TOLD YOU BEFORE, WE'RE OUT OF MEMORY, AND WHEN I SAY OUT OF MEMORY, I MEAN SO FUCKING OUT OF MEMORY THAT I WILL HAVE TO STOP WRITING THIS SCROLLTEXT, OR IT WON'T RUN ON A 520ST...

Strings.text: HI, YOU'RE LOOKING AT THE -BIG SPRITE DEMO-.   IT WAS CODED BY THE CAREBEARS.   THE MUZEXX WAS DONE BY -MAD MAX- OF THE EXCEPTIONS.   THE -'WHERE-HAVE-I-SEEN-THAT-BEFORE?'-LOGO- WAS DESIGNED BY -ES- OF TEX.   THAT WAS THE CREDITS, NOW WHAT ARE WE GOING TO WRITE ABOUT?   WELL, I CAN'T HELP IT BUT, I JUST HAVE TO SAY A FEW WORDS ABOUT THE DEFINITIVE DEMO, BY THE LOST BOYS  (WE WERE QUITE UPSET WHEN WE GOT IT, AND WE STILL ARE).   IT IS NOT AS BIG AS THIS DEMO, NEITHER IS IT AS GOOD, BUT THEY MANAGED TO RELEASE A FEW FUNNY EFFECTS, THAT HAS NEVER BEEN SEEN ON AN ST BEFORE.   THE MOST IRRITATING ONE IS THEIR TWISTSCROLLER, WHICH IS LOOKS VERY MUCH LIKE OUR DNA-SCROLLER.   THE PROBLEM WITH CODING DEMOS OF THIS SIZE IS THAT THERE'S A VERY LONG TIME BETWEEN WHEN YOU CODE A SCREEN, AND WHEN YOU FINALLY RELEASE IT.   SOME OF THE SCREENS IN THE CUDDLY DEMOS ARE MORE THAN A YEAR OLD.   IF WE HAD RELEASED THEM WHEN WE CODED THEM, SAY AS IN INTRO, THEY WOULD HAVE BEEN NEW AND REVOLUTIONARY.   ON THE NO-CREW-COPY-PARTY (WHERE WE CODED THE WHATTAHECK DEMO) ALL SWEDISH CREWS OF ANY IMPORTANCE SAW ALMOST ALL OUR SCREENS, SO IF YOU THINK THAT WE'VE STOLEN IDEAS WHEN YOU SEE SIMILARITIES BETWEEN OTHER SWEDISH DEMOS AND THIS DEMO, I'D RATHER SAY IT'S THE OTHER WAY AROUND.   THEY HAVE STOLEN IDEAS FROM OUR DEMO.   NOW, LET'S TALK ABOUT SOMETHING ELSE.   TODAY WE FINALLY GOT MUZEXX FROM MAD MAX OF TEX.   PEOPLE (ESPECIALLY OMEGA) ARE SAYING THAT THERE IS NO UNION.   WE AGREE TO SOME EXTENT  -  THERE'S NO INTENSIVE COOPERATION BETWEEN THE MEMBERS OF THE UNION.   WE DON'T EVEN KNOW THE DELTA FORCE, TNT-CREW, LEVEL SIXTEEN, EVEN THOUGH WE'D LIKE TO.   NEITHER HAVE I SEEN ANY CRACKS BY ANY MEMBER, EXCEPT FOR THE REPLICANTS LATELY.   ON THE OTHER HAND, TEX ARE ONE OF THE BEST CODERS, THE REPLICANTS ARE THE BEST CRACKERS AND WE ARE ONE OF THE BEST (NO, LET'S NOT BE MODEST) THE BEST DEMO-CODERS.   WE GET MUZEXX FROM TEX, AND AND THEY GET TO KNOW OUR NEW SCROLL TECHNIQUES.      A FEW MOMENTS AGO, TFE OF OMEGA CALLED US AND SAID HE HAD 'BULLSHITTED' US IN SOME OF THEIR SCROLLTEXTS, BECAUSE WE HAVN'T SENT OUR LOADER YET (WE TRADED IT FOR THEIR PACKER).   FIRST OF ALL, YOU MUST NOT BELIEVE ANY OF THE BULLSHIT-TCB-TEXTS IN THE OMEGA DEMO.   THEN, LET'S BULLSHIT OMEGA, ESPECIALLY THE FLYING EGG...   HEY, SCHMUCK (YES, THATS YOU, THE FLYING EGG), YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT TIME IT IS!   I HOPE YOU KNOW THAT THE AVERAGE HARDROCKER HAS A LOWER IQ THAN NORMAL.   THAT IS UNDERSTANDABLE, ALTHOUGH WHO ELSE WOULD TAKE A JOB, WHERE YOU ENDANGER YOUR LIFE EVERY DAY, INSTALLING ANTENNAS ON HIGH ROOFS?   WELL, NOT A NORMAL PROGRAMMER, ANYWAY...      THAT'LL HAVE TO BE ENOUGH...      LET'S WARP....

ON THE LAWN OUTSIDE NICK'S VILLA, THERE'S A PING-PONG-TABLE.  WHEN ALL THE MEMBERS OF TCB, TANIS AND A.D. ARE HERE, NICK'S COMPUTER-ROOM GETS VERY CROWDED, SO WE HAVE TOURNAMENTS IN TABLE TENNIS.   IF WE GIVE YOU SOME FACTS, YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO FIGURE OUT WHO IS THE BEST AT TABLE TENNIS....       AN COOL THINKS HE IS BETTER THAN NICK.   TANIS THINKS HE IS BETTER THAN AN COOL.  EVERYBODY WIPES THE FLOOR WITH A.D.   NICK IS BETTER THAN JAS.   TANIS HAS NO CHANCE WHEN HE'S PLAYING NICK.  TANIS HAS NEVER PLAYED JAS.   AN COOL THINKS HE IS BETTER THAN TANIS.   NICK IS BETTER THAN AN COOL.  JAS IS NOT AS GOOD AS AN COOL NOR TANIS.   JAS THINKS HE IS THE BEST.          NOW YOU SHOULD HAVE BEEN ABLE TO FIGURE OUT WHO IS THE BEST AT TABLE TENNIS, OR AT LEAST WHO WAS ON THE KEYBOARD WHEN THIS SCROLLTEXT WAS WRITTEN......

HI, YOU ARE LISTENING TO A FOUR VOICE 10KHZ DIGI SOUND DEMO! WE DON'T CHEAT IN ANY WAY (WE DO IN THE SPREADPOINT DEMO!), EVERY SOUND HAS VARIABLE FREQUENCY ON ALL FOUR VOICES! THE 10KHZ SAMPLINGS SHOULD GIVE BETTER SOUND QUALITY THAN THE AMIGA (IT NORMALLY USES LOWER FREQUENCY) BUT THE ST DOESN'T HAVE A FILTER.  LET'S WRITE SOME CREDITS. SOME OTHER GRAPHIXX WAS DESINGED BY TCB, BUT MOST BY ES OF THE EXCEPTIONS (GUESS WHAT, MEGANERD).     AN COOLS' FORST REACTION WHEN HE HEARD THIS PIECE OF MUSEXX WAS    IT SOUNDS LIKE HELL (SAME CONSTRUCTIVE COMMENT HE GAVE ABOUT THE SPREADPOINT DEMO (YES, HE WANTS TO MAKE IT CLEAR THAT HE HAD NOTHING TO DO WITH COMPOSING THE MUZEXX)).   ANYWAY, IT WAS (AS WE SAID EARLIER) COMPOSED BY KARSVALL.  IF YOU DON'T LIKE THE TUNE, YOU SHOULDN'T BLAME HIM ALONE, COZ HE MADE IT IN AN AEGIS SONIX LOOKALIKE PROGRAM, CODED BY THE CAREBEARS.   THERE WAS A MINOR BUG IN IT, IT REPLAYED THE SAMPLES AT THE WRONG FREQUENCY, WHICH MAKES THE TUNE SOUND "OFF KEY".  ANOTHER TUNE WAS MADE FOR THIS PROGRAM BY GROWTWIG, BUT WE DIDN'T INCLUDE IT. (SORRY GROWTWIG, BUT IT WAS AWFULLY SHORT)...   THIS PROGRAM WAS CODED MORE THAN A YEAR AGO. SOMEHOW, SOMEONE GOT HOLD OF A PREVIEW VERSION OF THIS PROGRAMME AND SPREAD IT....  WE WERE VERY ANGRY WHEN WE FOUND OUT, BUT THERE'S NOTHING TO DO ABOUT IT.   MOST SWEDISH CREWS ALREADY HAVE THAT PREVIEW, AND CAN INSPECT OUR DIGISYNTHROUT, BUT IT'S A PREVIEW, AND NOT NEARLY AS FAST AS THIS ONE, SO THERE...  THIS WAS A BORING SCROLLTEXT, WASN'T IT? WELL, IT DOESN'T MATTER COZ WE ARE GOING TO WRAP NOW....        ...      REMAKE BY MELLOW MAN!!

YOU CAN READ HOW WE GOT HERE IN THE STARWARS DEMO, BUT SINCE WE WROTE THAT SCROLLTEXT SOME THINGS HAVE HAPPENED, THAT MIGHT (OR MIGHT NOT) BE OF INTEREST.   THE DAY BEFORE YESTERDAY, WHEN THE STARWARSDEMO WAS FINISHED, WE FELL ASLEEP AT ABOUT 6 O'CLOCK - IN THE MORNING.  WHEN WE WOKE UP WE WERE VERY VERY HUNGRY (YES, YOU REMEMBER CORRECTLY - THE STORE WAS CLOSED THE LAST TIME WE TRIED TO GET HOLD OF FOOD).  WE FOUND TWO BIKES, SO TWO PEOPLE HAD TO BIKE TO THE STORE.  BEFORE -AN COOL- AND A.D. LEFT, WE TOOK A PAPER AND WROTE WHAT TO BUY.  WE WROTE:   16 LITRES OF COKE, 12 HAMBURGERS WITH BREAD, 3 BAGS OF CRISPS, 5 RAIDERS, 2 GOTT O BLANDAT" (CANDY), 200G MILKCHOCOLATE, 3 CANS OF RAVIOLI, 1 CAN OF PEASOUP (BLEURGH! (COMMENT BY NICK)), 2 LITRES OF ICECREAM AND 5 BANANAS.   EVERYBODY LOOKED AT -AN COOL- AND A.D. WITH BIG EYES AT THE STORE.  NOW THEY HAD TO STUFF EVERYTHING IN TWO BACKPACKS.
